comments.text: VIC patterns $00-$7F, eight scanline bytes per character. The airship field uses these for airship hull, interior girders and ladders. The VIC sees bank 0 and charset offset $2800 on the playfield.
Patterns $80-$FF for the airship charset at $2800. The high-index patterns are selected by map bytes in the same way as the lower 128.
A load-time $FF at the first working palette entry. Stage setup replaces it with $0B before the screen colour lookup reads this address.
